items.title: Global sections of a sheaf on the etale site of a field are the Galois invariants of its stalk
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the global sections of a sheaf on the small etale site of the spectrum of a field as the invariants, under the absolute Galois group, of its stalk at a fixed geometric point (statement lines 8667-8675). The proof contains two complete arguments: a formal chain of identifications through the equivalence between sheaves of sets and Galois sets, with each step attributed (proof lines 8678-8694), and a direct argument constructing a global section from an invariant element of the stalk (proof lines 8694-8729). The non-formal content is the compatibility of the equivalence with the group action. The claim is H2: two parallel arguments, the second written out in detail.
